## Summary

Describe the user-visible or technical change.

## Validation

- [ ] Release test suite passes
- [ ] Coverage remains at or above 90% without handwritten source exclusions
- [ ] Relevant manual controller/UI validation was performed or documented as not applicable
- [ ] User or developer documentation was updated when needed

## Manual testing

List controller models, connection methods, Windows/display configuration, and results.
Do not include personal device identifiers or unsanitized diagnostic captures.
